snippet.title: Cult Clicker Demo Annoucement
snippet.description:
Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574250/Cult_Clicker

Cult Clicker puts you in the shoes of a newborn God ready to start their first Cult.

You begin with limited time, skills and powers and as you harvest souls you increase your faithful followers, unlocking new and deadly powers, unlocking buffs and Acts Of God to become the one all-powerful deity!
